Patients present with neurologic symptoms (including tremor, action myoclonus, tonic-clonic seizures, later ataxia and dysarthria) that may precede, occur simultaneously or be followed by renal manifestations including proteinuria that progresses to nephrotic syndrome and end-stage renal disease. In some patients, sensorimotor peripheral neuropathy, sensorineural hearing loss and dilated cardiomyopathy are associated symptoms.

master.definition_en: An occupational lung disorder caused by inhalation of dust particles. It is characterized by bilateral interstitial lung infiltrates. Representative examples include asbestosis, silicosis, anthracosis, and talc pneumoconiosis.

curated.lethality_detail_zh: 长期在职业活动中吸入游离二氧化硅、煤尘或石棉等生产性粉尘并在肺内潴留引起不可逆结节与进行性大块纤维化；肺组织逐年硬化伴慢阻肺、肺结核（矽肺并发肺结核率高）、反复气胸、呼吸衰竭及肺源性心脏病而危及生命。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 脱离粉尘暴露后肺内纤维化进展仍可隐匿持续，目前无特效药物能够清除既定肺内粉尘或彻底逆转瘢痕结节，主要通过大容量全肺灌洗（早期）、汉防己甲素/抗纤维化评估、并发症（肺结核/气胸/COPD）防治及肺康复延缓恶化；终末期三期尘肺仅靠双肺移植重获新生。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: GBD 2021最新全球尘肺病负担研究估算2021年全球尘肺病致死约18,323例（95% UI: 16,041–20,916），中重度老龄职业暴露人群承受主要早死伤残负担。

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: GBD 2021中国尘肺专项研究估算中国2021年尘肺病相关死亡约8,214例（约占全球45%），模型估算现患约214,719例；国家卫健委职业病报告显示尘肺病长期占我国历年新报告职业病总数的约90%，国内累积生存确诊职业性尘肺患者逾45万人。
annual_deaths_china.source: GBD 2021 China Pneumoconiosis Burden Study (PMC12238073) / 国家卫健委

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球工业采矿、石材切割与制造发展中国家呈现极显著区域集中性，人造石英石台面高浓度矽尘近年来在新兴经济体引发大量年轻群聚性重度快进型矽肺。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国是全球尘肺病累计病例数与负担最重的国家，现存确诊劳动者逾45万人，尚有大量未获正规职业病诊断备案的无劳动合同矿工/石材粉尘作业农民工。

master.definition_en: A rare disease caused by compression of the celiac axis by an abnormally shaped arcuate ligament (the part of the diaphragm in which both pillars join in the midline around the aorta). Patients have recurrent abdominal pain, anorexia and weight loss. The pain is epigastric, and diarrhea or constipation may be present as well. Onset of pain will usually, although not always, be after food intake, and may be associated with nausea and emesis. Other symptoms may include lassitude, exercise intolerance and vomiting. Occasionally, a patient may show an abdominal murmur upon auscultation.

master.definition_en: Erythrokeratoderma 'en cocardes' is a rare genodermatosis characterized by circumscribed target-like (or 'en cocardes') erythematous hyperkeratotic lesions. These lesions, which remit and recur, affect the trunk and extremities and are accompanied by scaly plaques evocative of erythrokeratoderma variabilis. Onset usually occurs at birth or during early childhood. Only few cases have been described. Transmission is autosomal dominant.

master.definition_en: Staphylococcal necrotizing pneumonia is a rare, bacterial, pulmonary infectious disease, caused by a Panton-Valentine leukocidin-producing Staphylococcus aureus strain, characterized by severe respiratory failure, extensive, rapidly progressing pneumonia and hemorrhagic lung necrosis. Patients typically present with influenza-like symptoms, such as fever, cough, and chest pain, as well as hemoptysis, hypotension, leukopenia, and severe respiratory symptoms that rapidly evolve to acute respiratory distress syndrome and septic shock. High mortality is associated.

Onset of symptoms can occur between several months up to decades after the last dose of radiation. Patients with radiation-induced brachial plexopathy typically present with mostly unilateral progressive paresthesia, followed by weakness, atrophy, and pain.
